correctness.rationale: For every n>=1, four balanced copies of the two pole colours have exactly 4^3 choices of base shifts and 4^3 allowed difference triples. Fixing the differences reduces each right-hand vertex to an independent T_H(d) count. Both direct and convolution enumeration methods produce all 64 values; their histograms yield the two exact energy exponentials. Subtraction is 128*2^n times an inclusion-exclusion count of words containing three distinguished letters, proving strict positivity exactly from n=3. Independent tensor Fourier transforms verify the 4th moment normalization and values for n=1..4; these finite tests are secondary checks, not proofs for all n.

value.rationale: C4 and V4 are the two possible abelian group laws on a four-colour palette. Proper K_{2,n} colour counts do not see the law, but additive energy and the full Fourier fourth moment do. The result gives exact all-length exponential formulas, a natural sharp first-divergence threshold n=3, and an exponentially decaying relative difference. This is a complete structural invariant for a natural infinite family, not an arbitrary finite slice or a re-tabulation of known chromatic counts.
